Container.Name: kb-ingest
Container.Overview: The ingest worker for the knowledge library: turns a URL into a timestamped, summarized transcript and hands it to kb-service. STARTED IN ORDER: after kb-service. It needs the kb network (set the Network field to kb) and a bearer token that is also a key named ingest-worker in kb-service's KB_PERSONA_TOKENS.
Container.Description: Ingest worker for the knowledge library. CPU only, one job at a time, no database access. Start after kb-service.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Speech model cache. Re-downloadable: losing it costs a download, not data. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kb-ingest/models.

Config.Name: KB_URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. kb-service's address on the kb network. Leave the default.

Config.Name: KB_TOKEN
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Bearer token for the ingest-worker persona: the same value as the ingest-worker key in kb-service's KB_PERSONA_TOKENS. Blank on purpose; the container exits if it is unset.

Config.Name: POLL_SECONDS
Config.Description: Seconds to wait between claim attempts when the queue is empty.

Config.Name: MAX_MINUTES
Config.Description: Videos longer than this many minutes are refused.
